verdict.rationale: Medusa is a commerce platform with a hosted cloud offering, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no AI-training policy or opt-out. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: "Data sovereignty, SOC2, custom DPA" on the pricing page, and the general ability to self-host the open-source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
